title: New update is very bad
body: Interface in new update is very uncomfortable. It’s impossible to tap buttons at the low part of the screen. Please, fix this asap. Otherwise we will use other applications like to work with excel sheets
author: Grok108

title: Фильтры не работают
body: Работа с таблицами становится проблемой, если уже имеющиеся в таблице фильтры не отображаются. Оптимизация хорошая
author: Менеджер Елена

title: Fix the bugs!
body: It is impossible to work through the application, it reacts to commands from the fifth to sixth time, in some tables it simply crashes. It does not allow you to open the drop-down list in the cell, it closes immediately. You have to constantly work from your computer through a browser.
author: MitraKey
